entry.title: fix(html): add notes for dialog closedby=any touch propagation bug
entry.content:
Fixes #30474

<dialog closedby="any"> has a touch event propagation bug in Chrome 134–153
and Firefox 141+: tapping the backdrop closes the dialog but does not cancel
the event, causing click listeners on elements behind the backdrop to fire.

Changes:

  • Chrome: converted to array — clean entry for 154+ (fixed via
    bug 425579196), plus a 134–153 entry with a note
  • Firefox: added notes to the 141+ entry linking to
    bug 2022750 (still unfixed as of Firefox 156)
  • chrome_android, edge, and firefox_android correctly mirror their
    desktop entries — no additional changes needed

entry.title: html/elements/iframe: add local-network, local-network-access, and loopback-network allow directives
entry.content:
Fixes #30831

Adds three missing Permission Policy directive entries to html.elements.iframe.allow:

  • local-network: Chrome 145, Firefox 153, experimental: false
  • loopback-network: Chrome 145, Firefox 153, experimental: false
  • local-network-access: Chrome 142, Firefox false, experimental: true (legacy alias, superseded by the two above)

Firefox support verified via Bugzilla bug 1978550 (RESOLVED FIXED); network.lna.blocking defaults to true from the Firefox 153 release tag.

Note: http.headers.Permissions-Policy entries for these directives correctly remain false — Firefox has not implemented HTTP header parsing for Permissions-Policy (bug 1531012 is still open).

entry.title: Add pathLength to SVG geometry elements
entry.content:
Summary

  • Adds pathLength to <path>, <circle>, <ellipse>, <line>, <polygon>, <polyline> and <rect>
  • Support versions reflect actual rendering, meaning stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset scaled by pathLength
  • <path>: Chrome 50, Firefox 6, Safari 14
  • Other shapes: Chrome 57, Firefox 61, Safari 14
  • Safari reflected the attribute in the DOM long before it affected rendering

Test results and supporting details

  • Tested in Chrome 154, Firefox 157 and Safari 27 by drawing each shape to a canvas with stroke-dasharray in pathLength units and sampling pixels along the stroke
  • Chrome 50, <path>: https://crbug.com/536217 (r373110)
  • Chrome 57, other shapes: https://crbug.com/596043, https://codereview.chromium.org/2525233002 (r435194)
  • Firefox 6, <path>: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=643419
  • Firefox 61, other shapes: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1325320 (the stroke-dash code checks for <path> at FIREFOX_60_0_RELEASE and any shape at FIREFOX_61_0_RELEASE)
  • Safari 14: https://webkit.org/b/72401 (r254657, January 2020, WebKit 610), scaling applied to any SVGGeometryElement

Related issues

  • mdn/mdn#852
